scenarios.name: Base plan
scenarios.description: The 2027 plan as written, including the radiography and community nursing posts.

scenarios.name: Winter surge +28% from September
scenarios.description: Demand steps up 28% in September and stays up through the winter.

scenarios.name: Referrals +12%
scenarios.description: Every stream runs 12% above plan for the whole year.

scenarios.name: Recruitment freeze
scenarios.description: Every approved post is withdrawn. Nobody already in post leaves because of it.

scenarios.name: Funding -8%
scenarios.description: The modelled budget drops to 92% of plan.

scenarios.name: Shared record saves 8%
scenarios.description: The same work takes 8% fewer hours once the record is live everywhere.

scenarios.name: Sickness and turnover up
scenarios.description: Staff leave half again as fast as planned, across every team.

scenarios.name: Diagnostics cannot recruit
scenarios.description: A national shortage of radiographers hits one team and no other.

scenarios.name: Delivery risk +50%
scenarios.description: Every programme is half again as likely to miss.

scenarios.name: Mild winter, demand -8%
scenarios.description: The winter that does not come. Worth seeing, because the plan still has to hold.

scenarios.name: Winter surge with a recruitment freeze
scenarios.description: Both at once, which is how it usually arrives.

interventions.name: Send 18% of imaging to an independent provider
interventions.description: A contract takes routine scans off the department. Two months to mobilise, and it is paid for whether or not the winter comes.

interventions.name: Bring the radiography posts forward
interventions.description: Agency and bank cover while the substantive posts are filled. Nine months becomes three, at a premium.

interventions.name: Move 8 nurses to outpatient clinics
interventions.description: They can run clinics within the month. The visits they were doing do not stop existing.

interventions.name: Defer the Diagnostic Hub by 3 months
interventions.description: Push the start out and give three teams some air.

interventions.name: Stop the Discharge to Assess pathway
interventions.description: Drop it for this year and give Community Nursing its people back. You lose what it was going to save.

interventions.name: Half the Waiting List Recovery
interventions.description: Treat the longest waits only. Half the people on it, half the backlog cleared.

interventions.name: Roll the Shared Care Record out slower
interventions.description: A third fewer people on it, running well over half again as long. It lands later and everything downstream of it moves too.

decisions.question: Diagnostics will not hold the winter.
decisions.setup: Twelve radiography posts were approved this month. Advert, shortlist, interview, references, clearance and notice take nine months, so they are in post in October, a month into the surge they were approved for.

options.label: Bring the posts forward
options.why: Bank and agency cover while the substantive posts are filled. Nine months becomes three, at a premium.

options.label: Send routine scans out
options.why: An independent provider takes 18% of imaging. Two months to mobilise, and it is paid for whether or not the winter comes.

options.label: Hold the posts as planned
options.why: They arrive in July and the department runs hot until then.

decisions.question: Three programmes are drawing on the same seventeen improvement staff.
decisions.setup: The Diagnostic Hub, the Waiting List Recovery and Discharge to Assess were each planned as though the others were not happening.

options.label: Defer the Diagnostic Hub
options.why: Three months later. It was already waiting on the record rollout, so check whether this changes anything at all.

options.label: Treat the longest waits only
options.why: Half the people on the recovery programme, and half the backlog cleared.

options.label: Leave all three as planned
options.why: Everyone stays busy and the improvement team finds out in September.

decisions.question: The longest waits are in outpatients.
decisions.setup: A hundred and eighty people run the clinics, and the Waiting List Recovery is staffed out of the same rota that sees the patients.

options.label: Move eight nurses into clinics
options.why: Cross-training and backfill. They can run clinics within the month. The home visits they were doing do not stop existing.

options.label: Stop Discharge to Assess
options.why: Gives Community Nursing ten people back. You lose what the pathway was going to save.

options.label: Keep the plan as written
options.why: The waits are what they are.

decisions.question: One more call before the winter lands.
decisions.setup: The Shared Care Record is the thing everything else is sequenced behind, and Digital and Records is carrying it alongside the coding queue.

options.label: Roll the record out slower
options.why: A third fewer people on it, running well over half again as long. It lands later, and so does everything behind it.

options.label: Defer the Diagnostic Hub
options.why: If you have not already. The hub is the thing waiting on the record.

options.label: Hold the sequence
options.why: The record lands when it lands.

decisions.question: October, and the referrals are climbing.
decisions.setup: Whatever you have not spent is still available, and there are eight weeks before the peak.

options.label: Send routine scans out
options.why: If you have not already. Two months to mobilise means it is live for December and not for November.

options.label: Move eight nurses into clinics
options.why: If you have not already. It helps the clinics and it costs the community.

options.label: Take the winter as it comes
options.why: Change nothing else and hold what you have.

demoIntent.summary: A community health service whose bottleneck is physical, whose hiring takes six months, and whose every fix takes something from another service.
intents: Diagnostics is the constraint and cannot be hired out of inside a winter.
The Diagnostic Hub is sequenced behind a record rollout nobody linked it to.
Moving nurses into clinics is not free: the visits they were doing do not stop existing.

routes.name: Referrals that generate an imaging request
